findings.title: writeBriefing joins an unchecked lane label into the briefing path
findings.description: laneLabel builds a lane's label from the task ids the planner returned, and writeBriefing joins `${label}.md` under BRIEFINGS_DIR with no shape check (1156). A label carrying `/` or `..` writes the briefing outside .claude/ship/briefings/, and a leading dot writes a hidden file; nothing between the planner and this join validates the ids.
findings.suggestion: Use the label as the file name only when it matches a safe-name pattern; otherwise clean it and suffix a short hash of the raw label so two labels that clean alike still write two files.

findings.title: writeBriefing fails on a fresh checkout with no briefings directory
findings.description: writeBriefing writes into .claude/ship/briefings/ without creating it, so the first spawn of a run on a fresh checkout throws ENOENT.
findings.suggestion: Create the directory before the write.

findings.title: writeBriefing writes in place, so an interrupted write leaves a truncated briefing
findings.description: writeFileSync rewrites the briefing in place. A process killed mid-write leaves a truncated file under the label, and a resumed run that re-reads it hands the host a briefing whose hash no longer matches the header.
findings.suggestion: Write to a temporary sibling and rename it over the briefing.
